programmes.d: A stern father wants to see one of his own sons hang for murder - but he picks the wrong boy.
A showdown is set to take place between the blacksmith and a gunman who used to court his wife.
Marriage-shy Festus Haggen faces matrimony when his pretty cousin Mayblossom travels all the way from Texas by mule.
A newlywed man is shot moments after his wedding.
Marshal Dillon rides into the middle of a range war while pursuing an outlaw.
Doc Adams and Festus Haggen decide to catch some fish, but get caught themselves—by a clan of scruffy buffalo hunters.
A vengeful prisoner poses a continual threat to the life of Marshal Matt Dillon.
Matt and Chester get caught in the middle of a bloody mountain feud between the Peavys and the Cades.
Marshal Joe Phy uses his reputation as a gunman to maintain order.
A hillbilly girl hitches a ride into Dodge and her bullying brothers follow, soon getting her into trouble with the law
Three bounty hunters hold Doc, Kitty, Sam, and Louie captive in the Long Branch and offer to exchange them for a prisoner in jail.
A boy comes to Dodge City in search of his father only to learn that he is a wanted criminal
In Mexico, Marshal Dillon is befriended by a 13-year-old boy who sees Dillon as a man who can rid his village of all banditos.
Jed Hockett, a farmer, orders his three sons to go to town and not return without prospective brides.
Festus Haggen is charged with the job of finding a wife for Sweet Billy, one of his kinfolk.
Matt attempts to reform a young troublemaker (including James Nusser in a role other than Louie Pheeters).
An old man and his grandson prove themselves more than a match for four badmen who try to steal their prize Hereford cattle. (TV-PG)
A young man suspects his uncle of murdering his father.
A man whose sheriff father died as the result of bullying by four hard-bitten cowboys is relentless in his crusade for vengeance.

James Stacy guest stars as a personable thief, who doesn't relish the thought of a minimum two-year sentence because of his past record and, therefore, seeks to escape from Festus en route to the Dodge City jail.
A witness claims to have seen Matt kill Tom "Red" Samples' partner.
A young man steals a horse when he is accused of murder.

A boy's love for his guitar—all that is left from his late father's estate—leads to murder and a trail of trouble.
Matt Dillon's efforts to recapture an escaped murderer are complicated by Kitty's jealousy of the criminal's girlfriend.
An Indian woman faces prejudice for her father's raid on Dodge City.
A bitter old woman plots to kill Matt as revenge for the death of her brother.
A widow pursues a married man.
Morgan Woodward plays Bear Sanderson, a man who seeks his own revenge when outlaw Indians kill his wife and bum his home.

Michael Learned, best known as the mother on The Waltons series, plays a key trial witness and Paul Stevens plays the lawyer who, after much deliberation, accepts Marshal Dillon's plea to defend the Indians accused of murdering Bear Sanderson's wife.
A group of outlaws try to force an old prospector to give up his gold.
Matt suspects murder when a merchant is found hanged in his office.
